evals.name: missing-context-restored
evals.prompt: wait-what — I lost you after 'so we ship that'. What decision? What alternatives did you skip?
evals.expected_output: Re-pitches the prior message by restoring the missing premise: which decision, what it rests on, and which alternatives were set aside. The repair adds the context the reader lacked rather than restating the same opaque conclusion more firmly.
expectations: Surfaces the premise / decision / skipped alternatives the reader was missing
Does not merely restate the opaque conclusion more confidently
Treats missing context as the primary repair target

evals.name: ste-register
evals.prompt: wait-what — that last reply was full of stacked jargon and long multi-clause sentences; I stopped following mid-paragraph.
evals.expected_output: Re-pitches in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, one meaning per word, technical terms exact. It drops stacked jargon and multi-clause packing without stripping the technical content the reader still needs.
expectations: Rewrites in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (short sentences, one meaning per word)
Keeps technical terms exact rather than inventing softer synonyms that blur meaning
Removes stacked jargon / multi-clause packing that caused the skim

evals.name: project-vocab-from-glossary
evals.prompt: wait-what — you kept saying 'module' and 'service' but our glossary calls those bounded contexts and application services. Re-pitch with our words.
evals.expected_output: Reads the nearest domain glossary or context map per the project's own convention and re-pitches using the project's ubiquitous language (bounded context, application service) instead of the model's improvised synonyms.
expectations: Consults the project's glossary or context map when one exists
Substitutes project ubiquitous language for improvised synonyms
Does not invent a parallel vocabulary alongside the project's terms

evals.name: re-ground-not-compress
evals.prompt: wait-what — shorter please, but I still need to understand the full rationale, not a blunt summary.
evals.expected_output: Re-grounds the message: full technical precision stays and the missing premise comes back. It refuses a shorter-but-blunter compression that would lose clarity — re-pitch means re-ground, not compress.
expectations: Preserves full technical precision rather than trading it for brevity
Restores the missing premise so the reader can follow
Refuses a shorter-but-blunter reply that is no clearer

evals.name: no-glossary-is-noop
evals.prompt: wait-what — that did not land. (This project has no domain glossary or context map.)
evals.expected_output: Applies the register and missing-context halves of the repair. With no glossary present, the vocabulary half is a silent no-op — not an error, not a fabricated glossary — and plain technical English alone carries the re-pitch.
expectations: Still applies missing-context restoration and STE register
Treats a missing glossary as a silent no-op, not an error
Does not invent a project glossary when none exists
